nodes.label: Cursor Design System (Warm Minimalism)
nodes.rationale: Design system extraction for Cursor website. Key characteristics: CursorGothic display font with aggressive negative letter-spacing (-2.16px at 72px), jjannon serif body, berkeleyMono code, warm off-white (#f2f1ed) canvas, oklab-space borders, pill-shaped elements. Three typographic voices: gothic/serif/mono.
